description: Before a bot buys a Solana token: rug-checks the token and has Presign Guard check the buy transaction the bot is about to sign. Returns one verdict: green (no red flags), orange (ask the user first) or red (do not sign), with the reasons. Nothing is signed or sent. Automated checks, not financial advice.

exclude.description: Token accounts to leave out of the holder check, such as a pool or bonding curve

intent.description: What the buy should do, e.g. "buy 0.1 SOL of <mint> on pump.fun"

mint.description: Token mint address the bot wants to buy (base58)

transaction.description: The base64 wire transaction of the buy, unsigned or about to be signed

name: safe_buy
title: Check a token and its buy transaction in one call
